sentences.text: IPMA lists 17 active weather warnings in 25 areas of Portugal, of which 6 are orange and 11 are yellow.
For Lisboa today, 2026-11-19, IPMA forecasts a minimum of 12.8 °C and a maximum of 18.4 °C, with a 0% chance of rain.
In Porto, IPMA forecasts a minimum of 12.5 °C and a maximum of 16.6 °C, with a 100% chance of rain.
In Faro, IPMA forecasts a minimum of 11.8 °C and a maximum of 20.7 °C, with a 16% chance of rain.
